# Lvyv

> Lvyv helps international travelers discover China through local people, cultural experiences, and practical travel guides.

## Help and travel guides

- [Help Center in English](https://www.lvyv.com/en/faq/): Practical guides to planning a trip to China and using Lvyv.
- [中文帮助中心](https://www.lvyv.com/zh/faq/): 中国旅行及旅遇服务帮助文档。

## Explore Lvyv

- [Encounters](https://www.lvyv.com/encounters): Discover local travel experiences.
- [About Lvyv](https://www.lvyv.com/about): Learn about Lvyv and its approach to travel.

## Resource discovery

- [ARD resource manifest](https://www.lvyv.com/.well-known/ard.json): Machine-readable public resource descriptions.
- [Sitemap](https://www.lvyv.com/sitemap.xml): Published pages and localized FAQ sitemaps.
- [Robots.txt](https://www.lvyv.com/robots.txt): Crawler access directives.

Travel policies and service availability can change. Follow the linked pages and their official sources for current information.
